hero.title: Turn your customers into regulars.
hero.text: A loyalty card on your customers’ phones, a QR code on your counter. They scan, they buy, they come back. No app to install.

steps.title: Three steps, from counter to reward

qr.title: Display your QR code at the counter
qr.text: FOVE generates it in your colours. Print it and stick it next to the till or on your shop window.

signup.title: The customer creates their card in thirty seconds
signup.text: They scan and enter their first name and phone number. Their card opens in the browser, nothing to install.

scan.title: You scan their card at every purchase
scan.text: From the checkout phone. Points or stamps are added and the reward unlocks automatically.

counter.title: Built for the till, not the back office
counter.text: The scanner fits in a phone. Enter the amount, FOVE calculates the points, confirm in one tap. Every transaction records the cashier’s name, the location and the time.

rewards.title: Points or stamps
rewards.text: 1,000 CDF spent = 1 point, or a free coffee on the tenth visit. You set the rules, the caps and the rewards.

stores.title: Multiple locations
stores.text: Each location has its own QR code and team. A cashier only sees their own store.

stats.title: Figures that come from your sales
stats.text: Members, returning customers, points issued and rewards redeemed, calculated from your actual history.

online.title: Your online store counts too
online.text: An order paid on your website credits the same card as an in-store purchase. A refund removes the matching points. A widget adds the loyalty button to your website, whatever it runs on.
online.codeComment: Sending the same order again never credits it twice.

pricing.title: A fixed price, no commission on your sales
pricing.text: Switch plans whenever you like: your cards, your customers and their history stay intact.

developers.title: Developer documentation
developers.intro: The FOVE REST API connects a till, an online store or a back office to your loyalty programs. Full interactive reference: <link>OpenAPI</link>.

auth.text: Create a secret key in Integrations, with only the permissions you need (scopes). It is used server-side, never in a browser. and keys are kept separate.

idempotence.text: Every <post></post> requires a unique <header></header> header (8 to 120 characters). Replaying the same request returns the original response with <replayed></replayed>; the same key with a different body is rejected (422). E-commerce orders are also deduplicated by <orderId></orderId>.

items.customersList: List and search customers (cursor pagination, q filter)
items.customersLookup: Find a customer by externalId, email or phone
items.accountsCreate: Create a customer’s card in a program
items.transactionsCreate: Credit a purchase (points calculated by FOVE)
items.transactionsReverse: Reverse a transaction with an offsetting entry
items.ordersPaid: Paid order: customer matched, card created if needed, points credited

sdk.text: The <pkg></pkg> package handles authentication, idempotency keys and retries on network errors.

webhooks.text: Events: <events></events>. Each delivery is signed (<signature></signature> header, HMAC-SHA256) and retried up to 8 times on failure. Deliveries are visible in Integrations.

widget.text: A framework-agnostic script. It uses a public key (<key></key>) restricted to the domains you declare: it reads the public configuration and can never credit points. Paste it before <body></body> (WordPress, Astro, Next.js, Symfony or HTML).

errors.text: Errors take the form <shape></shape>. Common codes: <codes></codes>. Default limit: 300 requests per minute per key.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use and Service (the “Terms”) govern access to and use of the FOVE platform, published by Dizayna, by any merchant, brand or business customer (the “Merchant”).

purpose.title: 1. Purpose of the platform
purpose.text: FOVE provides merchants with a SaaS software solution for creating and running digital loyalty programs (points or stamp cards, in-store sign-up QR codes, Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes, mobile checkout scanner, customer CRM, WhatsApp follow-ups and an e-commerce integration API).

account.title: 2. Account creation and team access
account.professionals: Accounts may only be opened by professionals acting in the course of their business.
account.roles: The Merchant freely sets their team members’ access according to four strict roles: Owner, Manager, Cashier and Viewer.
account.audit: Every operation carried out with the scanner or from the dashboard is linked to the signed-in user and recorded in a time-stamped audit log.

plans.title: 3. Free plan, pricing and data continuity
plans.free: Every sign-up gives access to the Free plan, with no time limit and no obligation to enter a credit card, within the limits of its quotas.
plans.commission: No commission is charged on the Merchant’s revenue or sales.
plans.retention: No-deletion guarantee: when a subscription ends or the Merchant moves to a lower plan, no customer card or points history is deleted. Only features or new items exceeding the quotas of the active plan are restricted.

duties.title: 4. Merchant’s commitments and responsibilities
duties.text: The Merchant freely sets their rules for awarding points or stamps and their rewards catalogue. They undertake to honour the rewards legitimately unlocked by their end customers and to obtain their customers’ explicit consent before sending any promotional communication (SMS, WhatsApp or email).

dpa.title: 5. Data Processing Agreement (DPA — Article 28 GDPR)
dpa.text: In performing the service, the Merchant acts as the Controller of their customer database, and Dizayna (FOVE) acts as the Processor:
dpa.ownership: Exclusive ownership: the Merchant retains full ownership of their customer data. Dizayna refrains from any resale, rental or commercial use of the hosted customer databases.
dpa.isolation: Multi-tenant isolation: each merchant database is logically isolated. A customer registered with several merchants using FOVE has fully independent records and balances.
dpa.rights: Exercise of GDPR rights: FOVE gives the Merchant built-in one-click tools to export all of a customer’s data (JSON portability) or permanently anonymise their record (right to erasure) while preserving the accounting integrity of the points ledger.
dpa.security: Technical security: cryptographic hashing of passwords and card tokens, AES-256-GCM encryption of integration secrets, TLS connections and automated daily backups.

availability.title: 6. Availability, API and fair use
availability.text: Dizayna applies industry best practices to ensure high availability of FOVE, including during in-store checkout peaks. Use of API keys and webhooks is subject to rate limits designed to protect the overall stability of the service.

termination.title: 7. Termination and reversibility
termination.text: The Merchant may cancel their subscription at any time from their management area. Before or after cancellation, they may export their entire customer base and transaction history in standard CSV or JSON format.

contact.title: 8. Contact and legal information
contact.text: For any contractual question, support request or to exercise your rights, contact our team via the <contact>Contact & Demo</contact> page or read our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.intro: This summary explains who does what. It does not replace the contractual terms signed with each merchant.

controller.title: Who is responsible?
controller.text: Each merchant is the controller of their customers’ data (customer database, loyalty program). Dizayna, the publisher of FOVE, acts as a processor: FOVE hosts and processes this data on the merchant’s behalf, according to their instructions.

data.title: What data?
data.customers: End customers: first name, last name, phone number, optional email, card number, points and rewards history, consents.
data.teams: Merchant teams: name, email, role, activity log.

consent.title: Consents
consent.text: Joining the program and receiving marketing communications are two separate consents. Customers can refuse marketing and still keep their card.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.text: The fove.digital website uses Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to measure traffic and improve its pages. These tools only set cookies once you agree in the banner; without your consent, nothing is measured. You can change your mind at any time with the “Cookie settings” link at the bottom of the page.

rights.title: Customer rights
rights.text: The merchant can export all of a customer’s data and erase it from their record. Erasure anonymises the person: the points accounting history is kept without any data that could identify them.

retention.title: Retention
retention.text: An inactive customer’s data is kept for 36 months by default, a period the merchant can adjust. Expired sessions and verification codes are deleted automatically.

security.title: Security
security.text: Strict isolation between merchants, hashed passwords, secret card links never stored in plain text, encryption of integration secrets, audit log of sensitive actions, daily database backups.
